name: gpt-oss-120b-2gpu
_comment: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 on both R9700s. HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 is the two discrete cards; index 2 is the iGPU and must stay out. NCCL_PROTO=Simple and NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 are required on this host (see multi-gpu-EXAMPLE.json). Two tests match bench-model: short for throughput, long for thermals. Power cap is left at whatever is currently set.
